scientific_integrity: The theorem is a self-contained, same-model-reviewed counting statement. The exact link formula follows from the point-deleted Fano/Pasch correspondence, with separate rigidity and equality proofs. Small-instance checks are corroboration rather than universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Old named parameters form a Fano-free partial Steiner triple system; the ambient limit only forbids the seven-line Fano plane as a subhypergraph. Extensions are not required to remain partial Steiner. Earlier equivalent work in unindexed design literature cannot be excluded; no external or independent validation has been performed.
title: A sharp Pasch-overlap penalty for one-point types in the Fano-free homogeneous hypergraph
